power.set.function_zh: 设置仿真供电；开机要求工作管完全归位。

thermal.set_temperature.function_zh: 只写温度目标；实际温度与能量只在宿主 step 演化。

scene.set_end_seal.function_zh: 设置端封拆卸进度，映射为轴向退出及离轴停放；无机器人或接触求解。

scene.set_work_tube.function_zh: 设置工作管沿+X的示意拆卸移位；工作管内径未知。

scene.set_gas_connection.function_zh: 记录气口连接标志；气压、流量、密封性、置换和气氛组成均未求解。

power.enabled.meaning_zh: 仿真供电状态；不驱动真实硬件。

thermal.target_k.meaning_zh: 温度目标；调用成功仅确认目标已写入。

thermal.temperature_k.meaning_zh: 集中参数热模型真值；仅受信任 debug/evaluator 可读。

thermal.indicated_temperature_k.meaning_zh: 过程真值经过显式量化的理想显示代理，quality=estimated；不是厂家传感器精度。

thermal.heater_energy_j.meaning_zh: 宿主时间推进累计输入热量的内部真值。

thermal.heat_loss_energy_j.meaning_zh: 宿主时间推进累计散失热量的内部真值。

thermal.stored_energy_j.meaning_zh: 有效热容与相对环境温升之积的内部真值。

end_seal.left.withdrawal_m.meaning_zh: 左端封拆卸进度q：沿-X退出，q>0.06m后同时沿+Y离轴停放；零为装配位置，非电动行程。

end_seal.right.withdrawal_m.meaning_zh: 右端封拆卸进度q：沿+X退出，q>0.06m后同时沿+Y离轴停放；零为装配位置，非电动行程。

work_tube.withdrawal_m.meaning_zh: 工作管沿管轴抽出的距离；行程为场景假设。

gas.inlet.connected.meaning_zh: 气体入口连接的场景标记，不表示流量或已吹扫。

gas.outlet.connected.meaning_zh: 气体出口连接的场景标记，不表示背压或排气能力。

gas.flow_rate_m3_s.meaning_zh: 无流量模型与实测数据，值为 null/unavailable。

gas.pressure_pa.meaning_zh: 无压力模型与实测数据，值为 null/unavailable。

thermal_model.meaning_zh: 空载单温区集中参数热模型；固定UA，工作管与端封位置不影响系数；样品反应与气体过程缺失。
equations: C dT/dt = P_in - UA (T - T_ambient)，各恒定输入区间使用指数精确解。
低于目标时P_in=1500 W；达到目标后理想保持P_in=UA*(T_target-T_ambient)；目标调低或断电时被动指数冷却。
T_indicated=round(T-273.15,1)+273.15 K，按0.1°C网格量化；此理想显示quality=estimated，未建立传感器噪声。

heater_power_w.meaning_zh: https://www.carbolite.com/products/tube-furnace-range/universal-tube-furnaces/tf-range/ — TF1 12/60/300 technical table: maximum power 1500 W

reference_heatup_time_s.meaning_zh: https://www.carbolite.com/products/tube-furnace-range/universal-tube-furnaces/tf-range/ — 35 min to 100 deg C below maximum, empty quartz work tube and insulation plugs

reference_ambient_temperature_k.meaning_zh: Assumed 20 deg C start; manufacturer heat-up table does not state starting ambient.

heat_loss_w_k.meaning_zh: Assumed effective UA, giving 540 W loss at 1100 deg C and 20 deg C ambient (36% of rated power). One manufacturer heat-up point cannot identify both C and UA; no cooldown/hold-power calibration.

thermal_capacity_j_k.meaning_zh: Effective empty-system C = -UA*t/log(1-UA*(Tref-Tambient)/P), from 1500 W / 2100 s manufacturer heat-up point, assumed UA=0.5 W/K and ambient=293.15 K. This is not the measured heat capacity of any component.

scene_configuration.meaning_zh: 工作管/端封拆卸与气口连接的示意配置状态；几何映射无接触求解，不代表机器人或真实电动机构。
equations: 气路connected布尔状态只映射显隐；流量和压力保持null/unavailable。

work_tube_inner_diameter_m.meaning_zh: 60 mm is furnace bore / maximum work-tube outer diameter, not the work-tube inner diameter.

work_tube_mass_kg.meaning_zh: Selected work-tube material, wall thickness and mass are unconfirmed.

end_seal_mass_kg.meaning_zh: Individual end-seal component mass is unconfirmed.

gas_flow_rate_m3_s.meaning_zh: No flow controller, supply condition, conductance or flow measurement is configured.

gas_pressure_pa.meaning_zh: No absolute-pressure state solver or sensor is configured.

maximum_end_seal_withdrawal_m.meaning_zh: Illustrative removable-part scene travel, not a manufacturer actuator stroke.

minimum_end_seal_clearance_m.meaning_zh: Scene clearance rule before work-tube translation; not measured collision clearance.

maximum_work_tube_withdrawal_m.meaning_zh: Illustrative work-tube scene travel along +X; not a manufacturer actuator stroke.

end_seal_parking_y_m.meaning_zh: 端封拆卸后在+Y方向离轴停放的最大示意位移。

limitations: 厂家炉孔直径 0.060 m 不等于工作管内径。工作管内外径、材料和端封规格未由指定清单查明，保留 null；模型显示尺寸为显式 visual proxy 假设。
管式气氛炉的气路仅登记空间端口和连接场景标记，未实现气体流量、压力、气氛组分、泄漏、吹扫、反应或安全互锁。
厂家24段程序控制器及温程编排尚未实现；当前仅支持写入固定温度目标并由宿主step推进升温与理想保温，不将表格中的温程能力宣称为已完成。
热模型是按本型号 1500 W 和 35 min 到 1100°C 标定工况约束的集中参数代理；有效热容与散热系数并非厂商实测，单个升温时间不能唯一识别两者。
部件质量、部件惯量与摩擦未知为 null。URDF 仅将 37 kg 整体质量集中于 base_link，以整体包围盒近似惯量；可动部件不伪造独立惯性。
URDF关节的effort=1 N、velocity=0.1 m/s为格式要求下的示意占位限制，不是厂商执行器力或速度；真实值为null，端封和工作管并无已验证的电动执行器。
GLB/OBJ 是导出时静态姿态；原生 Blender 对象经场景适配器绑定。机械行程为建模假设，未实施碰撞响应、机器人抓取或真实硬件控制。
接口 read 不推进时间；宿主 step 共同推进已注册实例。去重仅为当前宿主内存，重启后不承诺恰好一次。
API 过滤内部真值；共享 Python 进程与可读工作区不构成安全隔离，应由宿主限制文件和进程访问。
Synthetic empty hot-zone lumped model, derived from the manufacturer 35-minute heat-up point with assumed 20 deg C ambient and UA; C and UA are not separately identifiable from that one point.
Maximum rated temperature is 1473.15 K; continuous manufacturer rating is 1373.15 K. This model does not enforce dwell-time limits or model degradation above the continuous rating.

Reference manufacturer heat-up configuration uses an empty quartz work tube and insulation plugs. Removal/seal position does not alter thermal coefficients; other configurations and cooldown are uncalibrated.
No sample temperature gradients, chemical kinetics, purge, pressure, gas flow, oxygen concentration, vacuum integrity, robot operation, collision safety, or hardware driver.
Scene sliding coordinates are an illustrative disassembly aid, not real motors or a furnace door hinge.
Indicated temperature is an estimated ideal display rounded on a 0.1 deg C grid and exposed in K, not a measured sensor accuracy claim.

Only trusted host step advances the shared TF1-world clock. Python API visibility filtering does not isolate Python introspection, shared memory or filesystem access; use a separate trusted host process for untrusted agents.

coverage.note_zh: 热核心一致（差 ≤0.003 K）；端塞、工作管、气路场景能力未搬；关节化 USD（1 个按键（碰到即触发）、5 个门/盖/阀等被动关节）；接口点 1 个（接口）；布局：台面、两人搬、正面 −y、前方留空 0.25 m；面板读数 heat(灯)
